key_idea: Volumes add: the answer is the cube root of the sum of cubes.
sketch: Read n side lengths, sum c^3 and print cbrt of the sum. O(n). Cubes reach 1e27 and the sum 1e32, far beyond 64-bit integers, so accumulate in (long) double; relative precision is ample for 1e-6. Inputs are floating point, not integers.
